The truly outstanding runs of the 1990 event were the 2 fast long leg efforts by Gary Staines (pulling through the field) and Paul Evans (front running in probably the best effort of the day).

Paul Evans astounded everyone by running the fastest long leg by a 20 sec. margin while Andy Lloyd made a welcome return to finish 2nd fastest on the short leg followed by Justin Chaston 3rd fastest and a somewhat surprised Stuart Paton in 6th fastest place on the short leg.

1990 has seen Paul Evans, one of Belgrave's newer members, poised to make a great international breakthrough in athletics. He is perhaps best known for his fine performance recently in finishing 5th in the 20-stage Sun Life Great Race.
